# DS-CORE project state

## Now
- Baseline: 49 requirements, 13 decisions (DEC-0012 TSO and DEC-0013 openraft accepted 2026-10-07), 17 findings; trace gate PASS (100% requirement and criteria coverage, 70 evals).
- Code: github.com/altius-indo/ds-core (local ~/work/altius-indo/ds-core), toolchain 1.96.1; components COMP-0001..0005 point at it.
- Done: TASK-0001, 0002, 0003, 0009, 0011, 0013, 0015, 0021, 0033; STORY-0021 and STORY-0036 done.
- In progress: TASK-0004 Raft on RocksDB, TASK-0006 membership, TASK-0007 elections (defaults 150 ms / 1.5-3 s), TASK-0010 transactions, TASK-0012 graph keys, TASK-0038 arm64 matrix.
- Durability dispatch 37732064883 is running the long evals: STORY-0001 E2 (1000 power cuts), STORY-0002 E1 (1 h), STORY-0003 E1 (100 kills), STORY-0007 E2 (1 h).

## Next
- Check durability dispatch 37732064883; mark TASK-0004, 0006, 0007 and 0012 done for each eval that passes, then run /reqforge:verify to record evidence.

## Watch
- TASK-0005 (Jepsen harness with Elle-style checker and cluster driver) blocks STORY-0005 E2, STORY-0008 E3, STORY-0027 E2 and STORY-0028 E3.
- Open questions Q2-Q8 in design/raft-ranges.md and Q2-Q5 in design/transactions.md; open DECs: client transport (TASK-0017), analytical-query marking (TASK-0024), operator language, Linux kernel/glibc floor.
- PO-unconfirmed thresholds: failover 10 s, 99.99% availability, RPO 5 min / 7-day PITR, 10% HTAP degradation, 30-day erasure, 16 MiB, one-hop 20 ms, 10M-edge supernodes, import 50k/s, operator ready in 10 min.
- Five THIN findings (RF-0009, RF-0010, RF-0015, RF-0016, RF-0017) need re-verification.
- Coverage waivers for 6 non-applicable taxonomy cells are not yet in reqforge.json.

Last reconciled: 2026-10-08
